# Nodejs

This mod adds a nodejs dev environment to code-server/openvscode-server, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `code-server` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-nodejs
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-nodejs|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Details

You can define the nodejs major version to be installed via setting the environment variable `NODEJS_MOD_VERSION` (accepts `16`, `18`, 20, etc. Minimum of `16`, defaults to `16`).

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/code-server-nodejs/
